## Learning Objectives

By the end of this week you should be able to:

1. Separate noise, bias, and variance as sources of test error.
2. Design a train/validation/test split and explain why the test set is used once.
3. Describe how error changes with model capacity, training-set size, and depth.
4. Explain the double-descent phenomenon and why it contradicts classical intuition.
5. Run a defensible hyperparameter search.
